nyheter.title: Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao faces transparency questions in Senate confirmation hearing
nyheter.summary: Hung Cao, the acting Navy secretary, fielded questions about his handling of updates to Congress and got into a verbal scuffle about suicide “mitigations” during his Senate confirmation hearing.

nyheter.title: Lawmakers challenge Trump’s push to bring steam catapults back to Ford-class carriers
nyheter.summary: The bipartisan pushback came during Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao’s confirmation hearing, where senators questioned the cost and capability trade-offs of returning future Ford-class carriers to steam-powered catapults.

nyheter.title: Peacoat Evicted from Navy Seabags After a Century at Sea
nyheter.summary: The traditional Navy peacoat will be no more. A new Navy uniform policy released on Friday removes the peacoat, acrylic V-neck sweater and dinner dress white jacket from a sailor’s seabag beginning on Oct. 1, 2027. Sailors may still wear the wool V-neck sweater. Instead of the dinner dress white jacket, sailors will now use the dinner dress blue jacket as the standard formal uniform year-round, according to the policy. nyheter.title: Royal Navy to Trial Northrop Grumman Test Aircraft on Carrier in 2027
nyheter.summary: The Royal Navy will trial Northrop Grumman’s Talon IQ autonomous testbed demonstrator off a Queen Elizabeth-class carrier next year, the First Sea Lord announced Tuesday. The trials will serve as the initial stage of the Royal Navy’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) program, which will see attack drones operate alongside its embarked F-35 Lightning II fighter aircraft. nyheter.title: Navy Quietly Removed USS Michael Murphy Commander in September
nyheter.summary: The Navy quietly relieved the commanding officer of a naval destroyer initially deployed as part of the Abraham Lincoln Carrier Strike Group, USNI News has learned. The Navy relieved Cmdr. Caitlin Cunningham on Sept. 27 due to a loss of confidence, a Navy spokesperson confirmed Tuesday to USNI News.
